summary: STARS Scheme: Strengthening Teaching-Learning and Results for States: — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items:  Collaboration: Government of India & World Bank
 Objective: Improve the quality of school education
 Target States: Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Kerala, Odisha
 Focus Areas: Teacher training, learning outcomes, inclusive education, and governance reforms
